rules: At0.22 replace frame4 with these pieces at exact start transforms; do not also render frames5/6/7.
Source cuts partition visible alpha240 material of frame4; hardware is intentionally fractured into shards.
Use fixed destination_size throughout. Source pivot is cell-local center; positions refer to that pivot.
Interpolate downward start_position to settled_position with accelerating progress; x uses smooth progress.
Rotation = lerp(0,settled_rotation,u) + flight_rotation*sin(pi*u), u clamped elapsed/settle duration.
Clamp pivot y so rotated bounding-box bottom never exceeds floor0; settle without penetrating ground.
Keep settled pieces visible permanently behind hero, harmless and noncolliding. Never swap them off at0.8.
New frame15 rubble may draw beneath fragments after first piece lands; do not replace the rigid pieces.
No scale squash, no opacity fade, no tiled grid motion: alternating spin and individual settle times separate shards.
Keep collision release0.22 and existing sound timing; motion acceptance still required.
